title.narrative: U-LEAD with Europe Phase II: Local School Rehabilitation for Resilience

description.narrative: Contract related to: U-LEAD with Europe Phase II: Local School Rehabilitation for Resilience - This 18-monthmeasure seeks to support war affected populations through the provision of conflict-sensitive and more resilient models of access to education and healthto conflict-affected communities. A first component will focus on access to education in areas that are particularly impacted by the Russian war of aggression, including those recently liberated from Russian military control and those hosting a large number of internally displaced persons. Assistance will be given in a flexible manner through local Ukrainian administrations(Hromadas) to tailor specific access-to-education models to local needs. This will include support to bothoffline and online schooling solutions, including for examplerehabilitation or construction of shelters, classrooms and other facilities (e.g. for sports or psychological support and counselling); or the provision of modular school-centres. The hromadas and school administrations will be supported e.g. in crisis management as well as psychological support to their employees and students. A second component will focus on the needs of the Ukrainian health system related to a growing number of Ukrainian patients having received medical support in EU and EEA countries.Support will be provided forthe safe repatriation to Ukraine of patients willing to return, as well as to strengthen the trauma surgery and treatment capacity of the Ukrainian health system, to limit the number of patients requiring evacuationand to accompany the rehabilitation of repatriatedpatients.

comment.narrative: Final revision of repair and reconstruction works at supported schoolsOutput indicator 1 Number of schools in waraffected municipalities able to resume education due to repair reconstruction efforts of damaged building

By the end of the reporting period all planned reconstruction works in twelve schools in waraffected regions were completed. However due to security reasons only nine schools in waraffected municipalities were or will be able to resume education offline in the following school year. Other three continue educational process in online mode due to the difficult security situation in the region.
